subject: apps/api/src/one-door.test.ts
because: GET /api/paper is deleted: the Paper list is the paper.list operation through the read door, so it leaves the list of routes waiting to become operations.

subject: apps/api/src/scenarios/paper.scenario.test.ts
because: The scenario lists Papers through the read door with ada.read("paper.list") instead of the deleted GET /api/paper; the writer moves from the header into the read's input, and the expectations are the same.

subject: apps/web/src/features/apply/apply-api.test.ts
because: The Apply picker's Paper list reads POST /api/reads/paper.list with the kind in the body instead of GET /api/paper?kind=cv; the case checks that path and body.

subject: apps/web/src/features/paper/paper-api.test.ts
because: listPaper and paperListKey are deleted. The case checks that readPaperList reads through the read door, and the refresh case seeds the owner-scoped catalog list key that the library now uses.

subject: apps/web/src/lib/coach-stream.test.ts
because: The Paper list is a catalog read whose cache depends on the paper resource, so a Coach job.move refreshes only the job reads. The case now checks that precise result instead of the old refresh of every legacy read.

subject: apps/web/src/lib/paper-qualification.test.ts
because: The list read sends its writer in the read's input instead of the x-paper-writer header, so the cases check the request body; coachPaperOptions and its file are deleted, and the qualified Coach case calls qualifiedPaperRead directly.

subject: apps/web/src/routes/paper-doc-open.isolated.test.tsx
because: The Paper page reads the list at reads/paper.list instead of the deleted paper route, so the expected request order names the new path; the order is unchanged.

subject: scripts/deploy-probe.test.mjs
because: The deploy probe reads the smoke CV list through POST /api/reads/paper.list instead of the deleted GET /api/paper; the recorded calls and the expired-session case follow the new path.
